name: encoding-reflection-field-walk-through-a-method-value
description: The field walk of encoding-reflection reads a call of Interface, Field or Elem through a method value as it reads a direct call: a method value of Interface on a reflect.Value holding a field, a method value of Field on a reflect.Value of a struct, and a method value of Elem on a reflect.Value of a pointer to one each convert every exported field's value to the empty interface, so an assertion of the result to an interface type retains the methods by which each exported field type implements it. A method of a field type that the interface does not require is reported.
pending: encoding-reflection's field walk names only the reflect.Value method a direct call expression resolves (contract/exemptions.json description): deadset-go reports each Validate method DS1101.
